CLAMAVCONF.description: Path to the ClamAV daemon configuration file.

SUPERVISORPIDFILE.description: PID file path for the supervisor process.

DATABASEDIR.description: Directory where ClamAV virus database files are stored.

User.description: User account under which the daemon should run.

DataBaseDirectory.description: Directory for temporary ClamAV files (e.g., database updates).

PidFile.description: PID file path for the clamd process (used when not supervised).

Foreground.description: Set to 'true' to run the daemon in foreground mode (requires daemon supervisor).

SUPERVISORARGS.description: Arguments passed to the supervisor daemon command.
